notes: No model is shipped or pinned by default. User chooses at runtime/serve time.
Local-only smoke test default for dev: ollama/qwen2.5-coder:1.5b (optional, not shipped). PRs must not add a bundled model.

rules: Keep at least 8GB VRAM free on B70 while CodeRed-418 training runs. No training-context allocation from EHC.
EHC rendering (Electron/Chromium) pins to primaryCard (7900 XTX) unless user changes. B70 reserved for training.
No heavy GPU compute in dev/CI while training is active. Small Qwen smoke tests only, on primary card.
On window/session close, kill its LSP/DAP and child processes promptly. Never leave orphaned node/python/lldb.
Before any GPU/CPU heavy step (GGUF quant, image build, docker VM), check headroom and ask. Stop at the heavy spot.

notes: Ears (STT) = whisper.cpp + a ggml model; mouth (TTS) = piper + a voice. Nothing is bundled or downloaded automatically (house rule): drop binaries into resources/sensory or ~/.eventhorizon/sensory, or set explicit paths here.
GET /api/sensory/doctor states exactly what is missing, what was tried, and where to install. Endpoints refuse plainly until the sidecars exist.

adapter: auto | system | engine | piper | byok. auto = Windows uses OS voices through the renderer (Web Speech API, Microsoft voices incl. the SAM family), Linux/mac/ARM uses the bundled engine with Pocket TTS (tiny, ~100M) or Qwen3-TTS (1.7B, multilingual).
engine adapter needs llama-tts.exe (ships with chonkllama) plus a TTS GGUF in ~/.eventhorizon/models (or set engineModel/engineMmproj).
voicesDir: drop wav/mp3 speaker recordings there; each becomes a selectable voice (voice cloning). Default ~/.eventhorizon/voices.
Nothing is downloaded automatically. GET /api/tts/voices lists adapters, the platform default, and every available voice.
SOP workflows live in .harness/sops/*.json: agent nodes run the real agent loop, script nodes run shell commands, gate nodes pause for human approval (or send work back to a chosen step).

defaultMode is the run-mode preference: "gated" (human gates pause; default) or "automated" (unattended: gates auto-approve and agent tool calls auto-approve). Each run can override via POST /api/sops/:name/run {mode}, and each SOP file can pin its own mode.
Adapted from Tencent LoopForge (MIT) - see docs/SOPS.md and NOTICE.md.

chatTemplate selects a canonical tool-capable Jinja template: "auto" detects the model family (qwen3, deepseek, gemma4, glm, granite, llama3, ...), or pin a family id / file / path. This restores tool calling when a GGUF's embedded template was stripped (supports_tools=false). Templates vendored from llama.cpp (MIT).
ctx caps the KV cache (llama-server otherwise uses the model's 40k+ trained context and can OOM alongside other GPU work).
gpu.heapFraction is the share of VRAM the Chonk pool reserves up front — lower it when other processes hold VRAM.
Agnostic defaults are always scanned first: ~/.eventhorizon/models + ./models (created by runtime:init).
ggufDirs below are machine-specific ADDITIONS. Users add folders via Model Manager > Choose folder.
binaryPath is machine-specific; leave empty on other machines to use the packaged resources/engine binary ladder.
gpu.policy per docs/GPU.md: deviceIndex pins a card, heapFraction caps the Chonk pool, pool=1 enables cross-vendor Chonk Buffer.
Installers ship resources/engine/ with pinned chonkllama release binaries (verified by SHA).
Opt-in deterministic line-manager. Default OFF. Operator review paramount. Deterministic guide, not a judge.
When off: no subprocess, no gating, no badge.
MCP client is live: stdio JSON-RPC 2.0, tools namespaced mcp_<server>_<tool> and merged into the agent toolset.
Shape: { "name": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem", "."], "env": {} } }
Servers spawn with an env allowlist (PATH/HOME/TEMP + their own vars) and are killed with the server process — no orphans.
Tool output is treated as untrusted data. Per-call approval follows the permissions block.
Detonation lane only. Clean worktrees never receive untrusted code.
BlackICE engram_vm pattern: pyvm, rv32, ti85, mathcheck, dataflow. Deterministic, no syscalls.
Model Gemma-4-12b-RedTeam-BlackICE is user-chosen at runtime if wanted (ChonkE/Gemma-4-12b-RedTeam-BlackICE on HF). Not shipped, not default.
